explanation: Amendment No. 1 (D032) set 185 seats effective 2025-09-01, and the CRM page (D004) still shows 185 active seats. Amendment No. 3 (D044) raises the count to 230 only from 2027-01-01, so on 2026-10-14 the figure is still 185.
